title: Bankwell Financial Group, Inc. Announces Date of Second Quarter Earnings Conference Call
summary: Bankwell Financial Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: BWFG), the holding company for Bankwell Bank, today announced that it will issue its earnings release for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on Thursday July 23, 2026. Management will also host an audio webcast and conference call at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time, on Thursday, July 23, 2026, to review the Company's financial performance and operating results. The audio webcast link, along with the corresponding presentation slides, will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations site ( https://investor.mybankwell.com/news-market-data/event-calendar/default.aspx ) prior to the beginning of the webcast. The webcast will also be archived on the Company’s website for twelve months and can be accessed at any time during this period. About Bankwell Financial Group, Inc.
